FANTASY FOOTBALL IS NOW LIVE! SUBMIT LINEUPS NOW!

🏈 Draft NFL legends from every era, build your roster, and win the Super Bowl in multiplayer playoffs against other players.

✨ Fuse Exotic cards. Pull Rookie cards. Complete a team's collection for huge rewards.
📈 Global leaderboards: best team, Super Bowl wins, playoff wins, best card.

NEW THIS UPDATE:  Head Coach Mode, Fantasy Football, Rookie Cards, Fusion

♻️ Trading

Updated every week. Join the group to get codes and report bugs. Next code at 2K likes.
